story.iWant: to apply the enhanced Card component variants to dashboard pages
story.soThat: dashboard pages use appropriate Card variants (metric, chart, info, role) for better visual consistency and improved UX
story.tasks: - Task 1: Audit dashboard pages for Card usage (AC: #1, #2) - Identify all dashboard pages using Card components - Document current Card usage patterns - Identify which cards should use which variants - Create mapping of pages to variant requirements - Task 2: Update dashboard home page (`src/app/page.tsx`) (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Review feature cards (Player Analytics, Team Analytics, Tournament Analytics) - Apply appropriate variants (elevated or interactive for feature cards) - Update role cards to use `variant="role"` with `roleType` prop - Verify visual consistency and design guide alignment - Test: Verify cards render correctly with new variants - Test: Verify no visual regressions - Task 3: Update player details page (`src/app/(dashboard)/players/[id]/page.tsx`) (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Identify statistics/metric cards - Apply `variant="metric"` to cards displaying large numbers (ELO, win rate, etc.) - Apply `variant="info"` to informational cards - Apply `variant="chart"` if chart cards are present - Test: Verify cards render correctly - Test: Verify statistics display correctly - Task 4: Update player statistics page (`src/app/(dashboard)/players/[id]/statistics/page.tsx`) (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Review analytics cards - Apply `variant="metric"` to metric display cards - Apply `variant="chart"` to chart containers - Apply `variant="info"` to informational cards - Test: Verify analytics cards render correctly - Test: Verify chart cards work properly - Task 5: Update other dashboard pages (AC: #2, #3) - Review clubs page (`src/app/(dashboard)/clubs/page.tsx`) - Review tournaments page (`src/app/(dashboard)/tournaments/page.tsx`) - Review games page (`src/app/(dashboard)/games/page.tsx`) - Apply appropriate Card variants to each page - Test: Verify all pages render correctly - Task 6: Verify design guide compliance (AC: #3) - Verify metric cards use 8px radius, 20px padding, subtle shadow - Verify role cards use 12px radius, 24px padding, 2px border, role-based colors - Verify chart cards have proper spacing for chart title and controls - Verify info cards have proper layout for icon + text content - Test: Visual inspection of all updated pages - Task 7: Component testing (AC: #4) - Test: Run existing component tests to verify no regressions - Test: Verify Card component variants work correctly in all contexts - Test: Verify TypeScript types are correct for all variant usages - Test: Verify accessibility is maintained - Task 8: Visual consistency check (AC: #3, #4) - Review all updated pages for visual consistency - Verify variant usage is appropriate (not over-applied) - Verify spacing and padding are consistent - Test: Manual visual testing across all dashboard pages

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Given the Card component has enhanced variants (metric, chart, info, role) from Story 3.2 When I review dashboard pages that use Card components Then appropriate Card variants are applied based on content type: - Metric cards use `variant="metric"` for displaying large numbers/statistics - Chart cards use `variant="chart"` for chart displays - Info cards use `variant="info"` for text content with icons - Role cards use `variant="role"` with appropriate `roleType` prop for role-based content - Feature cards use appropriate variants (elevated, interactive) based on interaction needs
2. And the following dashboard pages are updated: - Dashboard home page (`src/app/page.tsx`) - Feature cards and role cards - Player details page (`src/app/(dashboard)/players/[id]/page.tsx`) - Statistics cards - Player statistics page (`src/app/(dashboard)/players/[id]/statistics/page.tsx`) - Analytics cards - Other dashboard pages with Card components (clubs, tournaments, games)
3. And the Card variant usage: - Matches design guide specifications for each variant type - Maintains visual consistency across all dashboard pages - Uses appropriate padding variants (none, sm, default, lg) where needed - Preserves existing functionality and accessibility
4. And after applying variants: - All existing tests pass without modification - Visual appearance is improved and consistent - No breaking changes to component behavior - Card variants are used appropriately (not over-applied)

docs.doc: Enhanced Card component with metric, chart, info, and role variants. Metric Card: 8px radius (rounded-lg), 20px padding (p-5), subtle shadow. Role Card: 12px radius, 24px padding, 2px border, role-based colors.
Card variant specifications: Metric Card for large numbers with trend indicators, Chart Card for full chart display, Info Card for text content with icon, Role Card for role-based color theming.
Detailed card styling: Metric Card (8px radius, 20px padding, subtle shadow), Role Card (12px radius, 24px padding, 2px border, role-based colors), Base Card specifications.
ShadCN/UI copy-paste model - components in `src/components/ui/` directory. Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach. TypeScript 5.0.0 with strict mode.
Epic 3 goal: Players can view comprehensive role-based performance analytics. Scope includes role-based performance metrics, ELO rating, win rate analysis, and navigation/data display components.
Learnings from Story 3.2: Enhanced Card component with variants. Component location: `src/components/ui/card.tsx`. Testing patterns established. Design guide alignment verified.
